name: Easedup
description: Helps teachers create curriculum-aligned lesson plans, units of work, assessments, activities, and student-facing resources. Works standalone with your input, supercharged when you connect EasedUP curriculum servers for live standard lookups across Australian Curriculum v9, US Common Core, and UK National Curriculum frameworks.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**, **8 commands** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (3): `curriculum-alignment` (Search and reference curriculum standards using EasedUP MCP tools — applies when creating resources that require curriculum content…), `resource-creation` (Guidelines for creating K-12 educational resources — applies when teachers request lesson plans, units of work, activities, assessments,…), `teaching-strategies` (Teaching strategy selection and learning mode guidance for K-12 resource development — applies when designing lessons, units, or…)
- **Commands** (8): `create-activity` (Create a hands-on learning activity for K-12 students), `create-assessment` (Create a formative or summative assessment with rubric), `create-factsheet` (Create a concise student factsheet covering key concepts), `create-handout` (Create a student handout or worksheet), `create-lesson` (Create a curriculum-aligned lesson plan), `create-presentation` (Create a classroom teaching presentation with slides), `create-unit` (Create a unit of work spanning multiple lessons), `search-curriculum` (Search curriculum standards from EasedUP (Australian Curriculum v9, Common Core, UK National Curriculum))
- **MCP servers** (3): `easedup-acv9`, `easedup-common-core`, `easedup-uk-curriculum`

Installs with `claude plugin install easedup@claude-community` from `easedup/plugin`.
